This Lease Agreement made the `2025-06-01`, by and between `Doyle Grant` [name of lessor], of `3224 Brennon Street` [street address], State of `California`, hereinafter referred to as "Lessor", and `Hagenes Inc` [name of lessee], of `35685 Vergie Hollow` [street address], State of `California`, hereinafter referred to as "Lessee", collectively referred to in here as the "Parties", agree as follows:

### 1. DESCRIPTION OF LEASED PREMISES:
The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described `7480` square feet (SF) of `Warehouse` located at `59958 3rd Avenue` [street address], State of California.

### 2. TERM OF LEASE:
The term of this Lease shall be for a period of `1` year(s) `0` month(s) commencing on the `1` day of `June 2025` day of `June 2025`, and expiring at Midnight on the `1` day of `June 2026` day of `June 2026`. ("Initial Term")

### 3. BASE RENT:
The net monthly payment shall be `9993` dollars ($9993) per month. A security deposit of `5324` dollars ($5324) is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month
